## Purpose
Instructions for AI coding agents working in this frontend: the project is connected to Lovable, so they must not rewrite published git history.

## Accuracy
Accurate while the Lovable connection exists. It says:
- avoid force-pushing, rebasing, amending or squashing already-pushed commits, because that rewrites history on Lovable's side;
- commits pushed to the connected branch sync back into the Lovable editor, so keep the branch working.

## Used by
AI coding agents (Claude, Codex and others) reading the repo.

## Replication notes
Keep it if the replica stays connected to Lovable; otherwise it can be dropped. The text sits between `LOVABLE:BEGIN/END` markers.
